During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] operated a secret '''laboratory''' inside the manufacturing station [[S-Ipsus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the cultists embarked upon a plot to wipe out the [[Caarite]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and they refined an [[anti-Caarite virus]] within the laboratory, then shipped out several tanks of the virus from the facility aboard three [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. Shortly after the transports departed with their deadly cargo, the laboratory was raided by a strike team sent by the [[Metatheran Cartel]], a Caarite-ran trade organization.<ref name="OA" />
